newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Pangang Steel completes expansion.
newsitem.headline: China's Pangang Steel completes expansion.

text.p: China's Pangang Group Steel Plate Co Ltd has finished work on the second phase of a 9.5 billion yuan ($1.14 billion) project to boost steel and iron output, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
The newly completed phase would boost Pangang's production capacity of iron, steel and related materials by one million tonnes a year each, the newspaper said.
Work on the second phase ended in mid-March, it said but gave no further details.
